title: File System: File metadata (d_type parsing, lazy stat)
acceptance_criteria: file_entry struct defined: name, type, size, permissions, modified_time
d_type from getdents64 parsed: DT_REG, DT_DIR, DT_LNK, DT_FIFO, DT_SOCK
Lazy stat: metadata only fetched when explicitly requested
file_get_metadata(path, entry) calls stat syscall for size/permissions/time
File size formatted for display (B, KB, MB, GB)
Modified time formatted as human-readable date string
Unit test verifies metadata for known file matches stat output
